suggest.ext-curl: Enables the default cURL transport for api(): connect/read timeouts and no dependency on allow_url_fopen. Falls back to file_get_contents when absent.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Syntax-lint every PHP file in parallel
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan static analysis on src/ and tests/ (level 8)
scripts-descriptions.stan-examples: Run PHPStan over examples/ (level 0) to catch a usage sample broken by a public-surface change
scripts-descriptions.cs-check: Report code-style violations without changing files
scripts-descriptions.md: Run PHPMD mess detection on src/
scripts-descriptions.check: Run lint, cs-check, stan, md and test in sequence
